title: Enterprise data governance and lineage controls
workflow: Inventory canonical customer, account, ledger, payments and audit data
Assign legal entity, domain owner, steward and access policy
Trace transformations between source, event and report projections
Define precision, completeness, uniqueness and timeliness controls
Approve retention/residency and permitted downstream uses
Audit all exceptional access and produce reproducible lineage exports
invariants: Reports must disclose source snapshot and rule version
A projection cannot become an alternate financial book
Personal data usage limited to approved purpose
Lineage must survive source version and schema evolution
Data correction preserves financial and audit history
Unknown regulatory retention rules remain awaiting review
acceptance_tests: Report line traces to source journal and version
Unattributed derived KPI fails quality gate
Schema change invalidates incompatible projection until migration
independent_gate: Approved data ownership, local privacy/regulatory interpretation and executable lineage/access tests.
